scene.title: Merge Sort on [38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82, 10]
scene.summary: Merge sort recursively divides an array into halves, sorts the small sub-lists, and merges them back together into a ordered list.

beats.title: The Unsorted Array
beats.narration: Merge sort uses Divide and Conquer. It recursively breaks the problem down into smaller sub-problems.

beats.title: Divide into Halves
beats.narration: The array of 7 elements is divided near the middle into two sub-arrays: [38, 27, 43, 3] and [9, 82, 10].

beats.title: Sort & Merge Left Half
beats.narration: Recursively, [38, 27] becomes [27, 38] and [43, 3] becomes [3, 43]. Merging them yields [3, 27, 38, 43].

beats.title: Sort & Merge Right Half
beats.narration: On the right, [82, 10] becomes [10, 82] and merges with single element [9] to form [9, 10, 82].

beats.title: Final Merge Step
beats.narration: Comparing the front items of both sorted halves creates the complete ordered list from smallest to largest.

warnings.message: "arr_left" is positioned by 2 relations; the first one wins
